```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(haven)
library(gtsummary)
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(ggplot2)
library(rms)
library(predtools)
library(readxl)
library(dcurves)

df <- read_sav("C:\\polyp\\data\\polyp.sav")
```

## **TABLE SUMMARY**
```{r tbl, echo = F, eval = T, warning = F, message= F}
tbl_summary(df, by = nhompolyp, include = c(Age, Sex, TSUTDT, TSPDT, TSGD, HTL, Ruou, BMI, kichthuoclon, Paris, rightcolon),
            digits = c(all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),
                       all_continuous() ~ 1),
            statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})")) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = function(x) style_pvalue(x, digits = 3),
        test = list(all_continuous() ~ "t.test", all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"))
```

```{r split, include = F}
set.seed(123)
dfsplit <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.7)
df_train <- training(dfsplit)
df_test  <- testing(dfsplit)
```
## **PROP TABLE OF DATA SPLITTING**
Data
```{r prop1, echo = F, eval = T}
prop.table(table(df$nhompolyp))
```
Training
```{r prop2, echo = F, eval = T}
prop.table(table(df_train$nhompolyp))
```
Validation
```{r prop3, echo = F, eval = T}
prop.table(table(df_test$nhompolyp))
```

## **ROC CURVES**
``` {r roc, echo = F, eval = T, message = F, warning = F}
# WLE
mod1 <- glm(nhompolyp ~ WLE, data = df_train, family = "binomial")
pred <- predict(mod1, df_test, type = "response")
roc1 <- roc(df_test$nhompolyp, pred, ci = T)

# Tuoicao + Paris + kichthuoclon + rightcolon
mod2 <- glm(nhompolyp ~ Tuoicao + Paris + kichthuoclon + rightcolon, data = df_train, family = "binomial")
pred <- predict(mod2, df_test, type = "response")
roc2 <- roc(df_test$nhompolyp, pred, ci = T)

# WLE + Tuoicao + Paris + kichthuoclon + rightcolon
mod3 <- glm(nhompolyp ~ WLE + Tuoicao + Paris + kichthuoclon + rightcolon, data = df_train, family = "binomial")
pred <- predict(mod3, df_test, type = "response")
roc3 <- roc(df_test$nhompolyp, pred, ci = T)


# ROC curves
roc.list <- list(roc1, roc2, roc3)
ggroc(roc.list, aes = "color", size = 1, legacy.axes = T) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.3, size = 6, hjust = 0,
           label = paste0("WLE + 4 factors = ", sprintf("%.3f", roc3$auc))) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.2, size = 6, hjust = 0,
           label = paste0("4 factors = ", sprintf("%.3f", roc2$auc))) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.1, size = 6, hjust = 0,
           label = paste0("WLE = ", sprintf("%.3f", roc1$auc))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18)) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Sens, Spec", labels = c("WLE", "4 factors", "WLE + 4 factors")) +
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") + 
  ggtitle("ROC curves of 3 models")
```

## **MODEL SUMMARY**
``` {r test, echo = F, eval = T}
summary(mod3)
```


## **SENS - SPEC - ACC**
``` {r sen, echo = F, eval = T}
coords(roc1, x = "best", best.method="youden", ret = c("threshold", "accuracy", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
coords(roc2, x = "best", best.method="youden", ret = c("threshold", "accuracy", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
coords(roc3, x = "best", best.method="youden", ret = c("threshold", "accuracy", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
```


## **RISK SCORE**
``` {r risk, echo = F, eval = T}
for (score in 0:17) {
  y <- as.numeric(min(abs(coef(mod3))) * score + coef(mod3)[1])
  p <- exp(y) / (1 + exp(y))
  print(paste0("Score ", score, " have risk p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}
```


## **NOMOGRAM**
``` {r nom, echo = F, eval = T, message = F, warning = F}
d <- df_train[,c("nhompolyp", "WLE", "Paris", "Tuoicao", "kichthuoclon", "rightcolon")]
d <- zap_labels(d)

nom_labels <- c(
  nhompolyp = "Polyp Type",
  WLE = "White Light Endoscopy",
  Paris = "Paris Classification",
  Tuoicao = "Age",
  kichthuoclon = "Colon Size",
  rightcolon = "Location"
)

label(d) <- lapply(names(nom_labels), function(x) label(d[,x]) <- nom_labels[x])
label(d)

ddist <- datadist(d)
options(datadist='ddist')

f <- lrm(nhompolyp ~ WLE + Paris + Tuoicao + kichthuoclon + rightcolon, data = d)

nom <- nomogram(f, fun = plogis, funlabel = "Risk", vnames = "labels")
plot(nom)
```


## **OR PLOT**
``` {r or, echo = F, eval = T, warning = F, message = F}
cols <- df |> select(Tuoicao, HTL, Ruou, TSGD, kichthuoclon, Paris, rightcolon, nhompolyp)

res.list <- lapply(as.list(cols), function(x) fisher.test(x, y = df$nhompolyp))
tmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res.list, broom::tidy))
tmp <- data.frame(tmp)

p <- lapply(as.list(cols), function(x) chisq.test(x, y = df$nhompolyp)$p.value)
p <- c(do.call(rbind, p))

tmp$feat <- colnames(cols)
tmp$feat <- c("≥ 45 years old", "Smoking", "Using Alcohol", "Family history of colorectal cancer", ">= 5 mm", "Paris classification", "Location", Inf)
tmp$feat <- factor(tmp$feat, levels = rev(c("≥ 45 years old", "Smoking", "Using Alcohol", "Family history of colorectal cancer", ">= 5 mm", "Paris classification", "Location")))
tmp$p.chisq <- p
tmp$p.chisq <- sprintf("%.3f", tmp$p.chisq)
tmp$p.chisq <- as.character(tmp$p.chisq)
tmp$p.chisq <- ifelse(tmp$p.chisq == "0.000", "<0.001", tmp$p.chisq)
tmp$range <- paste0(sprintf("%.1f", tmp$conf.low), "-", sprintf("%.1f", tmp$conf.high))

ggplot(tmp[1:7,], aes(x = feat, y = estimate)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10), minor_breaks = NULL) +
  labs(y = "Odds ratio", x = NULL) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0.1, 20)) +
  theme_bw() +
  annotate("text", label = tmp$p.chisq, x = tmp$feat, y = 0.11) +
  annotate("text", label = tmp$range, x = tmp$feat, y = 15) +
  annotate("text", label = sprintf("%.2f", tmp$estimate), x = tmp$feat, y = tmp$estimate, vjust = -1) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
```


## **CALIBRATION PLOT**
``` {r calib, echo = F, eval = T}
d <- df_train[,c("nhompolyp", "WLE", "Paris", "Tuoicao", "kichthuoclon", "rightcolon")]
f <- lrm(nhompolyp ~ WLE + Paris + Tuoicao + rightcolon + kichthuoclon, data = d)

d$prob_pred <- predict(f, type = "fitted")

d$prob_bins <- cut(d$prob_pred, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), labels = FALSE)

d_calib <- aggregate(cbind(prob_pred, nhompolyp) ~ prob_bins, data = d, mean)

ggplot(d_calib, aes(x = prob_pred, y = nhompolyp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  # scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Mean Predicted Probability", y = "Observed Probability") +
  ggtitle("Calibration Plot for Polyp Data") +
  theme_bw()
```


## **DECISION CURVE ANALYSIS**
``` {r dca, message = F, warning = F, echo = F, eval = T}
df_test$pred <- predict(mod3, df_test)

dcurve <- dca(nhompolyp ~ pred, 
              data = df_test,
              as_probability = c("pred")
)

plot(dcurve)
```
